1. (Currently amended) A packaging substrate comprising: a packaging structure having a chip mounting surface and a bottom surface, the packaging structure having __a plurality of__ conductive paths formed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface, the conductive paths configured to provide electrical connection between an integrated circuit chip disposed on the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface, the packaging structure having an opening formed in the chip mounting surface proximate a perimeter of the packaging structure; and a stiffening microstructure disposed in the opening and coupled to the packaging structure, __wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to at least one of a bottom surface or a sidewall of the opening__.

2. (Cancelled)

3. (Cancelled)

4. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, __wherein the stiffening microstructure extends above the chip mounting surface and is configured to provide structural support to the packaging structure__.

5. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the chip mounting surface is on a solder mask layer, and the opening extends through the solder mask layer, __and wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to the solder mask layer__.

6. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 5, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a core layer disposed below the solder mask layer, the opening exposing a portion of the core layer, __and wherein the stiffening microstructure is in contact with the core layer__.

7. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1 further comprising: an integrated circuit chip mounted on the chip mounting surface, __wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to the packaging structure at a location spaced from the integrated circuit chip__.

8. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 7, wherein the stiffening microstructure includes __a lid that is thermally conductive__.

9. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 8 further comprising: a heat transfer medium providing a thermally conductive pathway between the lid and the integrated circuit chip, __wherein the heat transfer medium is in direct contact with both the lid and the integrated circuit chip__.

10. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure is a ring, __and wherein the ring is bonded to at least one of a bottom surface or a sidewall of the opening__.

11. (Cancelled)

12. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 1 further comprising a dielectric bonding agent coupling the stiffening microstructure to the packaging structure.

13. (Original) The packaging substrate of claim 1 further comprising a conductive bonding agent coupling the stiffening microstructure to the packaging structure.

14. (Currently amended) A computing device, comprising: a memory; and a packaged semiconductor device communicatively coupled to the memory, wherein the packaged semiconductor device comprises: a packaging structure having a chip mounting surface and a bottom surface, the packaging structure having an opening formed in the chip mounting surface proximate a perimeter of the packaging structure; an integrated circuit chip disposed on the chip mounting surface and communicatively coupled to the memory through the packaging structure; and a stiffening microstructure disposed in the opening and coupled to the packaging structure, __wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to at least one of a bottom surface or a sidewall of the opening__.

15. (Cancelled)

16. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the stiffening microstructure extends above the chip mounting surface __and is configured to provide structural support to the packaging structure__.

17. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the chip mounting surface is on a solder mask layer, and the opening extends through the solder mask layer, __and wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to the solder mask layer__.

18. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 17, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a core layer disposed below the solder mask layer, the opening exposing a portion of the core layer, __and wherein the stiffening microstructure is in contact with the core layer__.

19. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the stiffening microstructure includes __a lid or a ring, and wherein the lid or ring is bonded to at least one of a bottom surface or a sidewall of the opening__.

20. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a ground reference plane layer disposed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface of the packaging structure, wherein the stiffening microstructure is in contact with the ground reference plane layer, __and wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to the ground reference plane layer__.
